title: AI Brand Visibility Tools for B2B: What They Track and How to Choose
excerpt: What AI brand visibility tools track, what they cannot do, what two stand-alone trackers cost, and a 10-point checklist and 14-day test for choosing one for a B2B team.

meta.rl_answer: An AI brand visibility tool runs a fixed list of buyer questions through AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity and records whether your brand is named, linked or described correctly. Good tools show full answers, sources and history. No tool can give a reliable rank inside AI answers, because answers change from run to run. Test by hand first, then buy on what you can verify.
meta.rl_takeaways:
Tools track mentions, citations, share of voice, sources, sentiment and history. Keep mentions and citations separate.
Answers change from run to run: SparkToro found less than a 1 in 100 chance of the same brand list twice, so look for a rate, not a rank.
No third-party tool sees inside Google. Use Search Console's Generative AI report as a free first signal.
Surveys of B2B buyers disagree because each asks a different question: Forrester 94% use AI somewhere, Gartner 45% on a recent purchase, 6sense 26% to discover vendors.
Entry plans start near $29 to $95 a month, but prompts, engines and markets decide the real cost.
Run a 14-day test with the same prompts in every trial and compare each tool with a hand baseline.
meta.rl_faqs:
What is an AI brand visibility tool? | Software that runs a fixed list of buyer questions through AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews on a schedule and records whether your brand is named, linked or described correctly, compared with competitors.
What do AI visibility tools track? | Most report mentions, citations, share of voice, sources cited, sentiment and history. Ahrefs and Semrush both list mentions, citations and share of voice or a visibility score. Check that a tool keeps mentions and citations separate.
How much do AI visibility tools cost? | It varies. In November 2026, Peec AI listed $95, $245 and $495 a month for 50, 150 and 350 prompts, and Otterly listed $29, $189 and $489 a month. Both offer custom enterprise plans. Prompts, engines, markets and staff time decide the real cost.
Are AI visibility scores accurate? | They are directional. SparkToro and Gumshoe found less than a 1 in 100 chance that ChatGPT or Google's AI would give the same list of brands twice for one prompt, so a score from one day is a snapshot. Look for repeated runs and a trend.
Do I need a paid AI visibility tool? | Not to start. Test 20 to 30 buyer questions by hand, use Search Console's Generative AI report and the free Ahrefs and Semrush checkers. Buy software when your prompt list or markets outgrow a spreadsheet.
Can an AI visibility tool show my rank in AI answers? | Some report a position, but the order of brands in AI answers is close to random, so it is not a reliable measure. Use the share of runs in which you appear instead.
Do AI visibility tools fix problems automatically? | No. They show gaps. Someone still has to correct facts, write pages and earn mentions, so decide who owns that work before you buy.
Which AI engines should a B2B tool cover? | The ones your buyers use, on the plan you would buy. For most B2B teams that means ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Perplexity and Gemini. Entry plans often cover only some engines, so check the plan.
How many B2B buyers use AI to research vendors? | It depends on the question asked. Forrester found 94% use AI somewhere in buying, Gartner 45% on a recent purchase, and 6sense 81% use an LLM in an evaluation but only 26% to discover vendors.
How do I test an AI visibility tool before buying? | Write 20 to 30 buyer prompts without your brand name, run a hand baseline, trial each tool with the same prompts and competitors, compare the tool with your baseline, open ten answers to confirm the sources are real, and score each tool on a fixed checklist.
What is the best AI brand visibility tool? | There is no single best one. The right choice depends on the AI tools covered, the number of prompts, competitor benchmarking, reporting and price. Run a 14-day test on your own prompts before you pay.
Can I check my AI visibility for free? | Yes, by hand. List 15 to 25 buyer prompts, run them in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Mode, and record whether your brand appears, the sources cited and whether the facts are right. Repeat weekly.
Are AI visibility tools the same as GEO tools and LLM trackers? | Mostly. The labels vary, but each one runs prompts in AI tools and reports mentions, citations, share of voice and sentiment. They differ in coverage, frequency, benchmarking and reporting.
How do you track AI visibility? | Pick a fixed set of buyer prompts, run them on a schedule in the AI tools your buyers use, record mentions, citations and accuracy, and compare trends over weeks, not single answers.
How do I track brand mentions in ChatGPT? | Write 15 to 25 questions your buyers ask. Run each one in a new ChatGPT chat, and record whether your brand appears, what is said and which sources are cited. Repeat weekly with the same questions. A paid tool does the same thing at larger scale.
What are AI brand monitoring tools? | They are tools that run a set of prompts in AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity and record whether and how your brand appears. Some also track sentiment and competitor mentions. Vendors also call them AI visibility trackers or LLM brand monitoring tools.
How do you track brand visibility in Google AI Mode? | Run your buyer questions in AI Mode in a new session and record the answer, the brand names and the sources shown. Answers vary by person, place and time, so repeat the test and look at trends. If you buy a tool, ask the vendor whether it covers AI Mode.
Why should I track AI brand visibility? | It shows whether AI tools name your brand, whether they state your facts correctly and which competitors they name instead. You cannot see this in a normal rank report.

meta.rl_g_glossary:
Prompt | The question you type into an AI tool.
Mention | An answer that names your brand.
Citation | An answer that links to a page of yours.
Share of voice | Your brand mentions divided by all brand mentions in the test.
Proof of value | A short trial that checks a tool against your own hand test.
Engine | An AI search product such as ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity.
